title: Dresden Departures Board
description: Dresden VVO departure monitor with platform-style display

display_duration.description: Seconds to show this screen before rotating (use 86400 to stay on this view all day)

update_interval.description: Seconds between departure API refreshes (clock redraws every minute)

stop_id.description: Stop name or VVO stop ID (stored in config_secrets.json, not config.json). Names are resolved via the VVO pointfinder API.

stop_name.description: Short display alias for the header (stored in config_secrets.json). Shown instead of the API name; not truncated when set.

max_departures.description: Max departure rows (up to 8 without station header on 64px height; ~6 with header)

show_station_header.description: Show stop name at top of left panel. Disable to fit more departure rows.

timezone.description: Timezone for clock and departure times

weather_at_stop.description: Use Open-Meteo weather at the stop coordinates from VVO (recommended). When false, uses latitude/longitude below.

latitude.description: Fallback latitude for Open-Meteo when weather_at_stop is false or stop coords unavailable

longitude.description: Fallback longitude for Open-Meteo when weather_at_stop is false or stop coords unavailable

sidebar_percent.description: Width of the right panel (date/time/weather) as percent of display width
